title: ISC BIND rdata Denial Of Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service condition on vulnerable installations of ISC BIND. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of an rdata section with a length that is less than four. The issue lies in the creation of an error message when an invalid message class is specified. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to crash a remote instance of ISC BIND.
